Cabinda Fortress
historical
Die Festung Cabinda umfasst verwitterte Ruinen, die einst als koloniale militärische Hochburg an der Atlantikküste dienten.
A Cabindai erőd málladozó romjai egykor gyarmati katonai támaszpontként szolgáltak az Atlanti-óceán partján.
Fortăreața Cabinda prezintă ruine măcinate de vreme care au servit cândva drept bastion militar colonial pe coasta atlantică.
The Cabinda Fortress features weathered ruins that once served as a colonial military stronghold on the Atlantic coast.

recreational

Praia do Girassol este o fâșie de coastă nisipoasă, cunoscută pentru atmosfera sa relaxantă de la malul mării, lângă Portul Cabinda.
Praia do Girassol is a sandy coastal stretch known for its relaxing seaside atmosphere near the Port of Cabinda.

landmark

A Feira egy élénk szabadtéri piaci látványosság Cabindában, ahol a helyiek regionális árukkal és kézműves termékekkel kereskednek.

The Feira is a lively open-air market attraction where locals gather to trade regional goods and crafts in Cabinda.

museum

Museu de Cabinda prezintă artefacte tradiționale și expoziții istorice care detaliază bogata moștenire culturală a enclavei.
The Museu de Cabinda showcases traditional artifacts and historical exhibits detailing the rich cultural heritage of the enclave.

recreational

landmark

Ez a jellegzetes emlékmű Cabindában áll, mint a helyi történelmi események strukturális tisztelgése.
Acest monument distinctiv se află în Cabinda ca un omagiu structural adus evenimentelor istorice locale.
This distinctive monument stands in Cabinda as a structural tribute to local historical events.

landmark

Largo Pedro Benge is an urban public square that serves as a popular pedestrian gathering space in the heart of Cabinda.

recreational

natural

Pointe Tiamba is a coastal viewpoint offering elevated vistas over the Atlantic waters and the nearby industrial landscape.

landmark

A Baía de Cabinda egy széles tengerparti öböl, amely természetes kikötőt biztosít a cabindai exklávé partvonala mentén.

Baía de Cabinda is a broad coastal bay that provides a natural harbor along the shoreline of the Cabinda exclave.
